Esha: Quick ask  can we create a 1-page 'manager week 1 checklist' for offer packets? Keep it copy-paste friendly and <4 hours scheduled.
Jon: Yes. include who-to-contact (IT, Security, Facilities, Legal) with ready-to-send lines.
Priya: Add a tiny 30/60/90 template and three example goals for infra/product/platform.
Kelly: Security musts: MFA, disk encryption, KMS request if needed. Mark Must / ASAP / Optional.
Esha: Draft schedule (paste into calendar):
- Day 1 09:30 PeopleOps welcome (45m)
- Day 1 11:00 Team intro (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 Product context (45m)
- Day 3 10:00 30/60/90 planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 Infra & monitoring primer (60m)
- Day 5 15:00 Week 1 recap + feedback (30m)
Jon: 30/60/90 starter:
- 30d: meet partners, confirm access, ship small process fix.
- 60d: own backlog item, run planning cadence.
- 90d: deliver measurable ops improvement, draft OKRs.
Priya: Pasteable who-to-ask lines:
- IT: "Hi IT  please provision Okta group ROLE and laptop for NAME, start DATE."
- Security: "Hi Security  request KMS and runbook access for NAME."
- Facilities: "Badge access for NAME on DATE, building X."
Esha: Proposal: include 5-question end-of-week survey (access, docs, owners, meetings, pace). If access flagged, auto-tag IT.
OnboardBot: New-manager one-pager created and queued for People Ops review. Link: https://redwood.link/manager-week1-kit
Kelly: I'll proof tomorrow. Esha: can you finalise by Wed?
Esha: Yes. Will post final PDF+calendar file here when ready. :sparkles:
